title: Intake detector: query-log findings stranded in a non-terminal state
goal: intake's stranded-findings detector reads the committed store kb/_querylog and reports each finding whose newest record is candidate-gap, open source, no-fix or apply-failed and older than STRANDED_DAYS on HEAD's commit day: a stage source finding becomes a story to probe its host's provider, any other a bug; the fingerprint is the finding id and its state

gates.question: How many days without a new record make a non-terminal finding stranded (STRANDED_DAYS)?
gates.recommendation: 3: learn and apply run on every distill, so three quiet days mean no stage will move the finding
